ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity (white/light gray) to low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixels across the visible ventral surfaces of both lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe contains a large contiguous white region with ~20 discrete, circular black spots of varying radii; right lobe contains a high-density area of black linear and curvilinear pixel patterns interspersed with white; both lobes exhibit thick black trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 50 degrees; the base of the notch is situated at the water-line interface.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Moderately irregular trailing edge with frequent, low-amplitude peaks (3-10 pixels) and valleys; serration frequency increases significantly toward the distal lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Curvature transitions from a slight convexity near the median notch to a steep, linear upward sweep toward the acuminate distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-intensity, high-texture clusters of white and gray pixels (barnacle colonies) are localized exclusively on the extreme distal tips of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple sets of parallel black linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the medial-distal region of the right lobe and intersecting diagonal lines on the proximal left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the lobe apices; significant parallel-line scarring (rake marks) visible across the majority of the right lobe's pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique curvilinear, almost concentric swirl-like pigmentation pattern located in the lower-medial quadrant of the right fluke lobe.
